_comment: English body for prompt-case-api-contract. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output request/response schemas and an error table; mark undefined items unknown.
Inputs: API description, example requests/responses, and error codes.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Organise the API contract. Output endpoint, request_schema, response_schema and errors[] with code, condition and client_action. Schema fields must come from description/examples; mark undefined fields. Do not invent error codes not provided.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.检查点:
- Fields have example or description support.
- Error codes come from input.
- Undefined items are explicit.
sections.失败分支:
- Insufficient examples: mark undefined, do not guess types.
- Missing error branches: list gaps.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
